SUAS-001 — Structural Directional Framing

The first SuperUnicode Architecture Standard: core BiDi architecture, scope isolation and glyph mirroring.

SUAS-001 (SDF) is the first SuperUnicode Architecture Standard and the core architecture for bi-directional text layout, scope isolation and glyph mirroring. It is a non-negotiable invariant: every conforming renderer MUST resolve bi-directional text through the SDF engine.

Design

  • Single-pass, zero-allocation — a state-machine pipeline carried in the SCP and the SUTF/SUST decoding streams.
  • Dual-Mode Directional Resolver — Unicode Bridge classifies from SUCD BiDi; SCP directives are explicit; Native SUCS inherits.
  • Fixed isolate stack — push/pop are O(1) on an embedded fixed array; overflow/underflow are structural errors.
  • Framed output word — 64-bit: 31b codepoint, 3b dir_type, 1b mirrored, 29b reserved; renderers mirror instantly.

SCP directional directives

Codepoint Directive
0x00110101 SCP_DIR_LTR — set resolved direction left-to-right
0x00110102 SCP_DIR_RTL — set resolved direction right-to-left
0x00110104 SCP_DIR_ISOLATE_PUSH — open an isolate
0x00110108 SCP_DIR_ISOLATE_POP — close the active isolate

Full BiDi processing model (UAX #9)

For renderers that require lexical bi-directional layout, SDF also implements the full Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm processing model: paragraph levels (P1–P3), explicit embedding/override/isolate levels (X1–X8), X9 removal, weak and neutral resolution (W1–W7, N0–N2), implicit levels (I1–I2), and reordering with mirroring (L1–L4).

Feature Status
Single-pass deterministic consumption Yes
Zero heap allocation Yes
O(1) isolate stack push/pop on fixed array Yes
dir_type + mirrored metadata on every framed word Yes
Dual-mode direction resolution Yes
Full BiDi processing model (UAX #9) Yes
Explicit-only scope changes (four SCP directives) Yes

Reference implementation: include/suas/suas_sdf.h + src/suas/suas_sdf.c (freestanding C99, no heap), registered in suas_static.

Source of truth: docs/suas/SUAS-001-sdf.md in the repository.
